dataList.content:
Play with me, big bro.
哥哥，陪惜春一起玩吧。

This room's tooooo big for just Xichun.
这间屋子对惜春一个人来说实在是太大太大了。

You... never should have said that. To me.
哥哥你刚才……对我说了绝对不该说的话。

... I won't be visiting you ever, ever again.
……我再也不会来哥哥的房间了。

Wrath.
怒。

Xichun was once a child who found happiness in the smallest things. A child who used to like playing with me.
惜春会因为一点小事就高兴，而且这孩子在世上最喜欢的事就是和我玩。

But once she gets older, she'll be like every other child in Daguanyuan.
但惜春长大之后也会和大观园的其他所有子孙们一样……

She will resent me, envy me, and try to kill anyone else who's shooting for the seat of the Family Hierarch.
恨我、嫉妒我，会去除掉所有对家主之位虎视眈眈的人吧。

But... I hoped that she wouldn't come to hate me. So once again, I smiled.
但……我希望惜春不要讨厌我。因此，这次我也微笑起来。

I... I didn't have to die yesterday... I didn't have to die yesterday if you'd just helped me.
但凡你……但凡你出手相助，昨天的我就能活下来了。

Do you have any idea how much it hurts when they chop off your neck? It hurts. It really, really hurts, but you can't even scream.
脖子被割开的时候真的痛得要命，但是再痛也叫不出声。你知道吗？

... I wish for nothing but the worst sufferings in what's left of your miserable life.
……我希望你这辈子都只能活在痛苦之中。

Xue Pan never wanted to fight. He was a pacifist with a soft heart that could easily be brought to tears.
薛蟠哥哥从小就不喜欢打架，是个爱哭的孩子。

But after a few deaths, his every word became a stabbing thorn.
但死过了几次以后，他说的每一句话似乎都长出了刺。

And he gladly impales me with them as he curses me. And I end up hoping that everything that he curses me with comes true.
那些饱含诅咒的话语原封不动地刺入了我的心中。要是一切都像薛蟠哥哥说的那样就好了。

So I smiled again.
因此我再度微笑起来。

Baoyu, Grandma and Mother tell me that there are no other women in Daguanyuan who can possibly hope to match up to you... other than me.
宝玉，老太太和妈妈都说，我是这大观园里跟你最门当户对的女人。

Let's live the happiest life we can together, okay? We'll see only the pleasant sights, eat only the best food out there, and enjoy the beautiful luxuries life has to offer. Aren't you excited?
我们一起享尽荣华富贵、天伦之乐吧。期不期待？

Baochai loved me, but what she loved was not a person—only the light that I radiate.
宝钗姐姐喜欢我，但她所喜欢的并非是人，而是我所散发出的光辉。

Just as I loved her fragrance.
正如我喜欢宝钗姐姐身上散发的香气一般。

Letting the will of Daguanyuan carry me away would have had me wed big sis Baochai.
若我受大观园的愿望裹挟，就当然应该和宝钗姐姐缔结婚姻。

But this feeling she spoke of, this excitement, was nothing more than a heavy, cumbersome accessory.
但宝钗姐姐言语中的期待，对我而言只是沉重的装饰品而已。

It was unwieldly, and it was much more than what I deserved. So I smiled.
对我而言那既麻烦，又远超我所能承受的。因而我微笑起来。

So now you'd rather isolate yourself in this room?
你现在只打算窝在屋里了吗？

dataList.content:
Daiyu will now hate me for the rest of her life, just as everyone else in Daguanyuan does.
现在黛玉也会和大观园的其他人一样，用余生去憎恨我吧。

So it's better that I shut myself off in my room.
因此我还是把自己关在屋子里比较好。

She could have left me then, but she chose to remain by my side.
虽然可以离开，但黛玉还是选择留在了我身边。

Maybe it wasn't a choice at all. Maybe she was bound to me.
也可能，她只是被我束缚住了。

It's my fault that she has nowhere else to go.
是我将黛玉逼入了无处可去的境地。

So the only thing I could show her in response was...
所以我能给她看的，只有……
